title: Stress Relief
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Stress Relief,' the office experiences various stress-reducing activities, including a chaotic CPR training session, a humorous roast of Michael, and attempts at relaxation amidst conflicts and personal issues. The episode highlights office dynamics, character relationships, and humorous efforts to cope with stress.

main_threads.thread: Office stress management and humorous attempts to reduce tension

evidence.snippet: Michael: Come on Stanley. You're losing you. You're losing you. Do it!
Stanley: Yes. I had a heart attack. I would quit, but I'm too old to find another job and I don't have enough saved to retire. I feel like I'm working in my own casket.
Michael: We found ourselves on the less prepared side of things when Stanley had his… when his heart went berserk.
Rose: Okay. Well, a good trick is to pump to the tune of 'Staying Alive' by the Bee Gees.
Andy: Oh you can tell by the way I use my walk I'm a woman's man, no time to talk.
Dwight: We search for the organs. Where's the heart? The precious heart.
